name: Octree-based Raycasting
definition: Raycasting-Verfahren, das eine Octree-Struktur nutzt, um leere Raumregionen zu überspringen und die Traversierung zu beschleunigen.
summary: Octree-based Raycasting accelerates volume rendering by skipping empty space via an octree, distinguishing itself through dynamic voxel updates and concurrency handling.
